title: The microbiologist leak: experts judge the author doctorate-level
summary: Chris Ramsay tells of The microbiologist leak: experts judge the author doctorate-level, about 2023 at online, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: lot of that stuff. Uh, they seem to think that this person is definitely like doctorate level microbiology.

plain: Around 2023, an anonymous person who said they were a microbiologist, a scientist who studies tiny living things like bacteria, posted claims online about non-human intelligence. A man named Chris Ramsay tells podcast host Jesse Michels that people who looked closely at the writing think the author really does have doctorate-level knowledge of microbiology. That would make the leak harder to wave off as the work of an amateur.
